title: Jira Is Turing-Complete
summary: A research article demonstrating that Jira's workflow automation system is Turing-complete, meaning it has the theoretical computational power equivalent to any computer. The author likely shows how Jira's workflow rules, conditions, and actions can simulate basic computational operations like those in a Turing machine.
problem_solved: Proves that Jira, typically seen as a simple project management tool, has full computational capabilities comparable to a universal computer.
why_valuable: This demonstration is both academically interesting and practically significant—it reveals hidden computational complexity in enterprise tools and could inform discussions about automation system security and limits.
